# Tammy Holliday Photography

> Professional photography services in Gauteng, South Africa

## About
Tammy Holliday Photography is a professional photography service based in Gauteng, specializing in capturing life's precious moments. With over 10 years of experience, we provide artistic and emotive photography for weddings, maternity, newborns, families, matric portraits, and special events.

## Services
- Wedding Photography: Full-day coverage from ceremony to reception, including pre-wedding consultation and online gallery delivery
- Maternity Sessions: Studio or outdoor shoots celebrating the journey of motherhood (45-60 minute sessions)
- Newborn Photography: Capturing tiny details in the first 14 days of life with props and wraps provided
- Family Portraits: Creating lasting memories for all family sizes in indoor or outdoor settings
- Matric Portraits: Individual and group packages for matric students with multiple outfit changes
- Cake Smash Sessions: Fun first birthday shoots with cake and props provided
- Couples Photography: Engagement shoots, anniversary sessions, and romantic portraits
- Custom Photo Albums: Heirloom-quality albums starting from R2100 with premium materials

## Location
Based in Gauteng, South Africa, serving the entire region including Johannesburg, Pretoria, Midrand, and surrounding areas.
